summary: A linked range in the Data tab is now framed as the rectangle you picked instead of following the shape of the triangle.
details: The coloured frame around a linked range used to step down the diagonal of a triangle, because it followed only the cells that received a value.
It now closes over the empty corner, so the frame matches the Excel or dataset range the link actually covers.
The same applies to all three kinds of link: green for a workbook, blue for another dataset, purple for a calculated range.
